collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: An elder has started forgetting names and feels afraid: tell a friend, or keep a list.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Lately (subject) has started forgetting names. Not all of them. Just sometimes, a face (subject.he/she) has known for years, and the name simply isn't there. Today (young_villager), a young villager, waves and says, "Morning!" and (subject) waves back with a smile, and inside (subject.him/her) there is a cold little drop of fear.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) tells (friend) about it, quietly. (friend) listens, and doesn't say "Oh, everyone does that." (friend.He/she) says, "That sounds frightening." (subject) is so relieved (subject.he/she) nearly cries. They talk about what might help: saying names out loud, asking without embarrassment. Nothing is fixed. It is less lonely.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) starts a list on a strip of bark: names, and a little note beside each. "Big laugh." "Always has a basket." "Afraid of crabs." (subject.He/she) reads it in the mornings. It doesn't take the fear away. But some days it helps, and the list itself turns out to be a rather lovely thing to have.
